concepts.title: SCRAP RUSH
concepts.detail: Bold mainstream mobile cartoon 3D. Chunky smoothly beveled volumes, oversized but plausible tires, broad armor plates, expressive stocky raiders, matte toy-like painted surfaces with restrained wear, saturated warm orange sand, sunlit bone armor, vivid orange-red accents, small cool teal shadows. Soft clean ambient occlusion and bright clear sunlight, rounded readable rocks and dunes. Exuberant, immediately legible, approachable action. A premium stylized 3D mobile game look, never photorealistic or pixel art. Shapes feel designed and professionally modeled, not assembled from default cubes.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: one finished portrait art-direction concept for the existing Road Gunner mobile game, part of a five-style comparison.
Input images: Image 1 is the prototype gameplay screenshot to reinterpret; Image 2 is the supporting close-up reference for the original armored car and raider designs. Treat these as rough blockouts, not the target finish quality.
Primary request: transform the prototype into a polished, convincing game art concept in the specific rendering style below. Preserve its desert vehicle-combat identity, not its crude meshes or empty ground.
Subject: the same original heavy muscle car: long low hood, bone-colored improvised armor over rusty bodywork, dark rubber four wheels, wedge front battering ram with five large teeth, side armor with a few large spikes, two orange-red rear fuel cans, two exposed exhaust pipes, and a clearly separate roof-mounted automatic machine gun. Keep recognizable raiders wearing red rags, scrap shoulder armor, goggles and carrying melee crowbars. No licensed characters.
Composition invariant across the series: portrait 9:16 format; fixed elevated orthographic three-quarter view (about 50 degrees downward), absolutely no horizon. One car is the focal point near the middle, facing diagonally toward the upper right, about 24 percent of image width. Four raiders approach in the upper half; the roof gun turns independently toward one of them with one short readable tracer. Two scrap pickups nearby. Broad traversable sandy space, shallow dunes, a low rock cluster and a rusted barricade, a loose low rocky perimeter in the far upper area. Show the floor, wheels and compact arena clearly; keep action readable on a small mobile screen.
Presentation: generous breathing room, high-finish art direction board but a single cohesive gameplay scene, not a collage. At the top set a small understated 'ROAD GUNNER' followed by the large exact concept title specified below and the small style subtitle. Typography may match the style but must be impeccably legible. No actual HUD, joystick, health bars, phone frame, interface menus or extra labels.
Constraints: retain the same core objects, camera type and approximate staging across this series; only art direction, shape treatment, material rendering and lighting change. Vehicle remains a four-wheel muscle car, not a tank, monster truck or futuristic hovercraft. No gore. No additional vehicles, bosses, skyscrapers, busy props, logos from other games, watermarks, blur, extreme depth of field or cinematic ground-level perspective. This is a concept proposal, not a claim of an actual Unity screenshot.

concepts.title: DUNE FORMS
concepts.detail: Sophisticated minimalist low-poly mobile 3D. Clearly visible large polygon facets; angular deliberate silhouettes, clean flat-shaded surfaces, almost no tiny texture details. Geometric dune planes and sculptural angular rocks, simple angular raiders. Restrained ochre, chalk, terracotta and desaturated blue-gray. Elegant long crisp directional shadows and spacious composition. All essential car parts remain readable through smart simplification. Tactile architectural diorama-like clarity. This must be recognizably different from rounded toy cartoon: sharp planar geometry, muted limited colors, graphic negative space, no glossy PBR noise.

concepts.title: PIXEL RAID
concepts.detail: Premium hand-authored 2D isometric pixel art suitable for a mobile action game, with a consistent visible pixel grid and carefully clustered pixel shapes. The entire arena, car, raiders, dust, shadows and pickups must all be true-looking crisp pixel art, not 3D under a mosaic filter. Rich readable 32-color-style palette, warm sand, oxidized burgundy metal, pale armor, teal-black shadows, bright amber muzzle pixels. Clean stepped diagonals, deliberate dithering only in broad shade transitions, no blurred gradients and no mixed-resolution assets. The car should be a detailed legible isometric vehicle sprite, raiders tiny expressive pixel silhouettes. Crisp pixel typography for the title.

concepts.title: IRON WASTELAND
concepts.detail: High-quality stylized realistic mobile 3D, grounded materials and credible car construction while preserving a strong simplified silhouette. Believable dented oxidized steel, chipped pale paint, welded armor seams, dusty rubber, smoked windshield glass and sun-faded red fuel cans. Proportional human raiders with readable cloth folds and scrap armor, no excessive micro-detail. Sun-bleached ochre desert, restrained industrial red accents, warm neutral daylight, naturally grounded contact shadows and subtle sparse wheel dust. Physically plausible material response and illumination, but optimized-looking game geometry and readable broad color blocks. Elevated orthographic GAMEPLAY camera, not a car advertisement, photograph, cinematic low-angle image or dark gritty mess.

concepts.title: RUST & INK
concepts.detail: My preferred direction: an original dieselpunk graphic-novel game rendered as expressive 3D cel-shading. Bold variable-width dark ink contours, large deliberate shadow shapes, restrained screen-tone and directional hatch marks on shaded planes, tactile hand-painted wear confined to important edges. Rust red and burnt orange, weathered ivory, charcoal black and sparse petrol-teal accents. The muscle car looks aggressive, handmade and iconic; readable broad angular forms, asymmetrical patched armor, simple strong raider silhouettes. Dynamic but tightly controlled dust strokes and one graphic muzzle burst. Warm desert daylight with dramatic graphic shadows; the scene remains clear, sunny and mobile-readable. A cohesive playable-looking world with inked surfaces, not a comic panel grid or a splash poster with a giant central character. Avoid photorealism, neon cyberpunk, soft toy-like plastic and noisy scratch texture everywhere.
